subject: Privileged ops log snapshot request + data-use declaration
messages:
From: Maya Patel <maya.patel@novamed.com>
To: grace_oconnor@redwood.ai
Cc: audits@novamed.com
Date: 2027-04-11T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: snapshot of privileged-ops/admin logs + data-use declaration

Hi Grace,

Per our SOC 2 evidence request (control CC7), NovaMed needs a timebound snapshot of the privileged operator/admin activity ledger covering 2027-03-01 to 2027-04-01. Specifically we need: 
- all privileged API calls and console admin events (create/delete/modify privileged roles)
- operator identifiers (redacted where necessary) and role IDs
- timestamps (ISO8601), request IDs, and correlated model inference request IDs when present
- a manifest with HMAC/SHA256 checksums and file-level byte counts

Two additional asks: 
1) A short data-use declaration describing who at Redwood will be able to access these artifacts, how long the snapshot will be retained, and whether the snapshot will be used for any analytics beyond evidence delivery (even aggregated).
2) A redaction map explaining what fields will be masked/pseudonymized and the algorithm (e.g., one-way salted hash, deterministic truncation).

We expect delivery to a pre-authorized S3 bucket. Please include the transfer checklist and any chain-of-custody steps. We are working to close the SOC 2 evidence intake by 2027-04-18.

Thanks,
Maya Patel
Security & Compliance Lead
NovaMed Health

Attachment: novamed-evidence-request-20270405.pdf (pdf, 180KB)

From: grace_oconnor@redwood.ai
To: Maya Patel <maya.patel@novamed.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-04-11T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: snapshot of privileged-ops/admin logs + data-use declaration

Hi Maya — thanks for the clear list. We can produce the snapshot and manifest you describe. Quick notes and proposed next steps: 

- Scope: we will capture the admin/privileged operator ledger (operator actions that change config, role grants/revokes, access key creates/deletes, and direct console-based privileged ops). We will also include correlated request IDs when present; if an inference request ID is present we will include it, otherwise the operator action will have its own request_id.
- Redaction: by default Redwood will pseudonymize operator identifiers with a salted HMAC (salt per-export) and provide the redaction_map describing fields removed and hash salts have been recorded in the manifest (salt itself is not shared). If you require reversible mappings for legal reasons, we need a signed data processing agreement addendum — let us know.
- Retention: snapshots we deliver for audit evidence are retained in our secure export staging S3 for 7 days post-delivery, after which an automated irreversible purge runs unless NovaMed requests a longer window. We can extend retention to 30 days on request.
- Delivery: we will upload to the pre-authorized NovaMed bucket (please share the bucket ARN and a short-term role). Exports are signed with SHA256 and we will provide a signed manifest (HMAC + timestamp).
- Usage: Redwood will not use exported snapshot contents for training or analytics. Aggregated telemetry (counts, e.g., number of privileged ops per day) may be retained in our internal metrics systems for product reliability; these aggregates have no PII and are not linkable to snapshots. We will include this statement in the export README.

Next steps: 
1) Confirm bucket ARN and IAM role or presigned-upload instructions.
2) Confirm desired redaction policy: pseudonymize (default) or reversible mapping (requires addendum).
3) Confirm desired retention window (default 7d).

I'll loop in Karthik (infra) and Vanessa (compliance) to scope the export timeline — we can target 2027-04-13 delivery if we get bucket access today.

— Grace
Grace O'Connor
Director, Product Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference

Attachment: privileged_ops_snapshot_requirements.pdf (pdf, 42KB)

From: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
To: grace_oconnor@redwood.ai, vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-04-11T12:10:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Request: snapshot of privileged-ops/admin logs + data-use declaration

Forwarding Maya's request and Grace's reply — operational notes below: 

- Export matrix: we will include the admin_event table, the privileged_call table, and the operator_role_history table. 
- File format: gzip CSV per table, each file chunked by day (to make partial re-ingest easier). 
- Checksums & signing: we will compute SHA256 for each file and then HMAC the manifest with the export-specific key. KMS key policy already allows exports to be signed by the export-service role.
- Redaction approach: implement salted HMAC pseudonymization on operator_id and operator_email fields. Keep role_id intact. Record the salt identifier in manifest (do NOT include raw salt).
- Estimated size: preliminary estimate ~1.2GB for the month window. 
- Timeline: if Grace approves, we can spin export job today and aim to place artifacts in the provided bucket by 2027-04-13 17:00 PT.

Questions for Grace: any constraints on compressing/per-file chunk sizes? Any special chain-of-custody label required by NovaMed (they mentioned "signed manifest" — want to confirm whether they need a notarized timestamp or just HMAC + signature).

-Karthik

Thanks Grace and Karthik — this looks good. A couple of clarifications before you run the job: 

1) Please keep chunk sizes under 250MB where possible (NovaMed SIEM team prefers small parts for parallel ingest).
2) For chain-of-custody, HMAC + signed manifest is sufficient; no notarization required. Please include the export-service role ARN in the manifest and the UTC timestamp of the HMAC.
3) Retention: 14 days would be ideal. Can you confirm if you can do 14 days?

If you can confirm those three items, we'll share the bucket ARN and a short-lived upload role by EOD.

Best,
Maya
